source.geography: ABS ASGS Edition 3 Local Government Areas 2025
source.note: Seeded from ABS LGA 2025 for NSW, excluding Unincorporated NSW and statistical special-purpose codes (128 LGAs). Direct-to-consumer retail food businesses notify the local council; manufacturers/wholesalers and some home businesses that do not sell direct to consumers notify the NSW Food Authority. Food/form links verified from council websites and ABLIS where cited.

unincorporated.label: NSW Food Authority pathway / unincorporated areas
unincorporated.notes: Notify the NSW Food Authority if you are outside a council area, or if you manufacture/wholesale without selling direct to the final consumer (including some home-based businesses that do not sell direct). Direct-to-consumer retail usually notifies the local council instead.

councils.name: Albury Council
councils.notes: Complete Notification of a food business form. Satisfactory inspection required before handling food for sale.

councils.name: Armidale Council
councils.notes: All food businesses must register/notify under Food Act 2003. Food and drink businesses page covers notification and FSS requirements.

councils.name: Ballina Council
councils.notes: Retail outlets notify Council via Fixed Food Premises Application Form (fee). Low-risk home manufacturers notify NSW Food Authority online.

councils.name: Bathurst Council
councils.notes: Food business notification form required. Free pre-start EHO advice/inspection recommended. DA often required for fit-out.

councils.name: Bayside Council
councils.notes: Online register paths for food premises, home-based food, and temporary/mobile food businesses.

councils.name: Bega Valley Council
councils.notes: A-Z Forms lists Food Business Notification, Temporary Food Stall Application, Mobile Food Vending Application and pre-purchase inspection application PDFs.

councils.name: Bellingen Council
councils.notes: Notification of a Food Business application PDF. Mobile vendors must notify. Mandatory/follow-up inspections with fees. Food Inspection Program via EHO.

councils.name: Blacktown City Council
councils.postal_address: Environmental Health Unit, PO Box 63, Blacktown NSW 2148
councils.notes: Register via eServices or registration form. Home prep not retailed at the premises may need NSW Food Authority notification instead of Council.

councils.name: Blayney Council
councils.notes: Food business registration form PDF. Temporary stall application (incl. Millthorpe Markets). Home-based food needs food safety plan and EHO inspection before production. Routine inspection/enforcement program.

councils.name: Blue Mountains Council
councils.notes: ABLIS lists Food Business Notification (online) and Food Business Registration Form PDF for Blue Mountains City Council, plus temporary/home-based guidance links. Risk-based administration fees listed for 2025-26. Prefer council site when a dedicated food hub URL is confirmed.

councils.name: Broken Hill Council
councils.notes: Complete Food and Health Premises Registration/Change of Details Application before commencing. Permanent, mobile and temporary covered. FSS requirements noted.

councils.name: Burwood Council
councils.notes: Business Premises Registration Form and Temporary Food Event Notification Form (OpenForms). Scores on Doors participant.

councils.name: Byron Council
councils.notes: Permanent, temporary and mobile food businesses must apply for approval. Inspection fees apply.

councils.name: Camden Council
councils.notes: Online Food Notification Form covers new premises, ownership change, detail updates and mobile vans.

councils.name: Campbelltown City Council
councils.notes: Food Business Registration Form required before opening. Risk-based inspection frequency published.

councils.name: Canada Bay Council
councils.notes: Complete business registration form and email Council. Temporary stall notification also required. PIN for failure to notify temporary stalls published.

councils.name: City of Canterbury Bankstown
councils.notes: Food Premises Registration Form before trade. Mobile food/drink registration form separate. Retail butchers/wholesalers → NSW Food Authority.

councils.name: Central Coast Council
councils.notes: Fixed premises must register with Council. Temporary/mobile vendors at Council events use temporary and mobile food business notification. Scores on Doors participant.

councils.name: Cessnock Council
councils.notes: Food Business Registration Form. Visiting temporary/mobile traders notify with home-council registration evidence. Nil fee to notify intention to trade.

councils.name: Clarence Valley Council
councils.notes: Fixed Food Premises Notification online form. See Food Businesses hub for related permits.

councils.name: Coffs Harbour Council
councils.notes: Online Notification of Food Business Form after development consent. Change of details within 7 days via same form.

councils.name: Cootamundra-Gundagai Council
councils.notes: Food Business Reg-Update Form for retail premises. Mobile vendors notify and need Section 68 for public land; vehicle inspected. Temporary events may need S68/DA. Home-based guidance and FSS requirements on Food Safety page. EHO inspections use FPAR.

councils.name: Cowra Council
councils.notes: Retail businesses notify Council. Annual inspections of cafes, mobiles, stalls, home catering. Contact Environmental Services EHO for requirements.

councils.name: Cumberland Council
councils.notes: Temporary food businesses must notify before applying to trade at events. Contact Council for fixed-premises registration pathway.

councils.name: Dubbo Council
councils.notes: Retail premises use Food Premises Notification of Proprietor Details. Separate temporary and home-based registration forms published. Wholesale also notifies NSW Food Authority.

councils.name: Edward River Council
councils.notes: All retail food businesses must register with Council. Medium/high risk premises routinely inspected. Covers restaurants, mobile vans and temporary stalls.

councils.name: Eurobodalla Council
councils.notes: Register/notify via Notification of food business PDF. Regular Food Surveillance Officer inspections under Food Inspection Program. Fit-out to AS4674 for builds/renovations.

councils.name: Fairfield Council
councils.notes: Registration of Business/Facility form covers food premises. Subject to routine EHO inspections with fees. ABLIS lists Food Business Notification for Fairfield City Council.

councils.name: Federation Council
councils.notes: Retail food outlets notify Council of business and food activity details. Food Business Registration Form used for fixed/mobile/temporary. Regular EHO inspections. Mobile/temporary subpage has downloadable form.

councils.name: Forbes Council
councils.notes: Online Food Business Registration Form. Starting a Business page covers home-based food and health approval. Contact Economic Development / EHO for premises suitability.

councils.name: Georges River Council
councils.notes: Separate notify paths for retail, home-based and temporary/mobile. Notify before trade, on change of details, or when ceasing.

councils.name: Glen Innes Severn Council
councils.notes: Register with Council before operating under Food Act 2003. Home-based food not exempt development; must meet AS4674. Annual administration fee for registered businesses (NFP exempt). EHO inspection/education program. Standard 3.2.2A from Dec 2024.

councils.name: Goulburn Mulwaree Council
councils.notes: Fixed Food Premises Registration Form including home-based. Temporary/mobile registration forms on Food Safety page. Fit-out guide for new premises. Inspection program via EHO.

councils.name: Griffith Council
councils.notes: Food Business Notification Form PDF on Food businesses page. Temporary event stalls also notify. Risk-based inspections (high risk twice yearly).

councils.name: Gunnedah Council
councils.notes: Notify Council of food activity details. Food Premises and Food Vending Vehicle Registration form available. Inspection fees after EHO visits; no fee to register.

councils.name: Hawkesbury Council
councils.notes: Register as food business prior to operation; Temporary Food Premises Form for mobile/temporary. Home-based: discuss with Council Health Officers before starting.

councils.name: Hilltops Council
councils.notes: Registration forms for new businesses available by contacting Council. Retail inspection program under Food Regulation Partnership. Contact Council early when starting.

councils.name: Hornsby Council
councils.notes: Register retail food premises online; Home Based Food Premises Notification Form for home kitchens. Temporary/mobile forms on same page. Contact 9847 6039 for inspections.

councils.name: Hunters Hill Council
councils.notes: Notify of Food Business Details before operating. Mobile Food Vending Vehicle Permit required for on/off-street vending. Garaging-council inspections; phone 9879 9400.

councils.name: Inner West Council
councils.notes: Home-based food manufacturers notify Council. If less than 50% of product is sold direct retail, notify NSW Food Authority instead. Temporary/market stalls need a Food Vendor Licence.

councils.name: Inverell Council
councils.notes: Registration of New Food Premises form satisfies Food Act notification. Design/fit-out to FSANZ 3.2.3 / AS4674. Food Complaint form available. Contact Civil and Environmental Services.

councils.name: Junee Council
councils.notes: Food Safety page with free I'm Alert training for food handlers. Contact Council for registration/notification and inspection requirements.

councils.name: Kempsey Council
councils.notes: EHO inspections of retail, mobile and temporary food businesses (~200/year). Mobile vendors must notify Council. Check temporary event requirements before trading.

councils.name: Kiama Council
councils.notes: Must register food business with Council and notify of changes. Home-based food businesses need a Development Application. Food & Drink Premises Guideline covers registration forms.

councils.name: Ku-ring-gai Council
councils.notes: Online food business notification form when taking over or starting. Planning/CDC may be required for new food and drink use. Most businesses need FSS.

councils.name: City of Lake Macquarie
councils.notes: Contact Duty Planner before notifying. Online registration form. Retail butchers/wholesalers register with NSW Food Authority.

councils.name: Lane Cove Council
councils.notes: Food Premises Registration Application and temporary vendor form. Home-based/mixed businesses use registration pathway; contact Duty Planner for home business planning.

councils.name: Leeton Council
councils.notes: EHO inspections typically twice yearly ($100/inspection noted on page). Category B enforcement agency for retail hospitality.

councils.name: Lismore Council
councils.notes: Food Premises Registration, Food Home Business Registration, market stall and mobile van applications on Food businesses page. Inspection before commencing after construction. Home-based guidance on same page.

councils.name: Lithgow Council
councils.notes: Food Premises Business Registration or Information Update form required. Free pre-start EHO discussion/inspection recommended. Mobile vans and temporary events pages under Food Services. DA usually required for new fit-out.

councils.name: Liverpool Council
councils.notes: Notify using Health Business Registration Application Form before trading. Risk-based inspection frequency.

councils.name: Maitland Council
councils.notes: Fixed premises notification form required. Separate temporary/mobile pathway. Inspection fees for medium/high-risk.

councils.name: Mid-Coast Council
councils.notes: Notify via online customer portal (Permits & Licences). Home-based: check zoning with Duty Planner; direct-to-consumer → Council, wholesale → NSW Food Authority.

councils.name: Mid-Western Council
councils.notes: Food businesses hub covers registration, food safety and mobile/temporary. Food Premises Notification Form on planning forms; ABLIS lists online notification. Mobile/temporary need Section 68 for Council land. Inspections via EHO partnership with NSW Food Authority.

councils.name: Moree Plains Council
councils.notes: Food and Drink page with Registration form for food business, mobile vending application and temporary event forms. EHO inspections and complaint investigation. DA required for structural changes/new fit-out.

councils.name: Mosman Council
councils.notes: Food Premises Notification Form for new/change/close. Published inspection fee schedule by risk category.

councils.name: Murray River Council
councils.notes: Notify and register prior to operating under Food Act 2003. Includes home-based, mobile and temporary. Building/planning permit may also be required.

councils.name: Muswellbrook Council
councils.notes: Food Premise registration form required before operating. Includes temporary/mobile and related notification guidance. Inspection program via EHO.

councils.name: Narrabri Council
councils.notes: Food Business Registration Form required before conducting a food business, including temporary events and mobile vendors. Change of ownership/contact/FSS also notify. Self-assessment form for internal use. Inspection program via Environmental Compliance.

councils.name: City of Newcastle
councils.notes: Nil fee to submit Food Business Notification. Inspection/admin fees invoiced after inspection. You can commence after submitting notification (no permit issued).

councils.name: North Sydney Council
councils.notes: Register before operating. Home food prep needs CDC/DA — otherwise use a commercial kitchen. Annual administration fee charged.

councils.name: Northern Beaches Council
councils.notes: Free Food Business Owner Details registration. Separate Home Food Business Application and Temporary Food Stall Application published. Inspection fees apply.

councils.name: Orange Council
councils.street_address: Cnr Byng Street and Lords Place
councils.notes: Register via dedicated food business form. Home-based food businesses need CDC or DA and may be inspected. Temporary/mobile Food Vendor Events Permit. Inspection fees under Fees and Charges.

councils.name: City of Parramatta
councils.notes: Regulated Food Business Registration Form for cafes, home retail, mobile vendors and canteens. Separate temporary outlet registration for events.

councils.name: Penrith City Council
councils.notes: Retail food businesses must register. Home businesses need planning approval before food registration is processed.

councils.name: Port Macquarie-Hastings Council
councils.notes: Notify Council of food activity details (or hold NSW Food Authority licence where required). Home kitchen must meet commercial fit-out standards; EHO final inspection before opening.

councils.name: Port Stephens Council
councils.notes: Business Registration Form for fixed, mobile and stalls. One-off registration fee for MFV/stalls. Fines for failure to notify.

councils.name: Queanbeyan-Palerang Council
councils.notes: Online Notification of conduct of food business form. Covers restaurants, mobile, home-based and temporary. Routine inspections; pre-purchase inspection available (fees apply).

councils.name: Randwick Council
councils.notes: Business notification and registration required for permanent and temporary food businesses. Routine inspections apply.

councils.name: Richmond Valley Council
councils.notes: Food Premises hub. Food Business Registration / Change of Details PDF covers commercial, mobile, stall, home-based. Notify before conducting food business under Food Act s100.

councils.name: Ryde Council
councils.notes: Download forms to register food business and notify changes. Inspection program for businesses required to notify Council.

councils.name: Shellharbour Council
councils.notes: Register with Food Business Registration Form. Home-based that retail from home notify Council; those that do not sell from home notify NSW Food Authority. Inspection fees apply. Temporary stall and mobile vendor forms on same page.

councils.name: Shoalhaven Council
councils.notes: Notify before commencing trade (new premises or change of owner/details). Includes stalls and mobile vendors. Inspection and administration fees apply.

councils.name: Singleton Council
councils.notes: Home-based food: check Duty Planner for consent, then notify via Food Business Update Form. Direct-to-consumer regulated by Council; wholesale-only notifies NSW Food Authority. Subject to Food Safety Program inspections.

councils.name: Snowy Monaro Council
councils.notes: Complete Food Premises Notification Form before commencing. Covers permanent, mobile and temporary food businesses. Home-based and temporary sections on same page. Inspection program via Environmental Health.

councils.name: Strathfield Council
councils.notes: Application to Register a Business PDF on Food Businesses page. Return to Environmental Services. Inspections against Food Safety Standards.

councils.name: Sutherland Council
councils.notes: All retail food businesses must register. Online registration form. Unannounced inspections at least yearly.

councils.name: City of Sydney
councils.street_address: Town Hall House, Level 2, 456 Kent Street
councils.notes: Register food premises before opening. Development consent/CDC required. Home-based food needs planning consent then registration. Temporary stalls: register at least 28 days before trading.

councils.name: Tamworth Council
councils.notes: Online Food Notification Form covers fixed, home-based and temporary/mobile. Public Health page covers new food business guidance. EHO inspection before temporary food sales.

councils.name: Temora Council
councils.notes: All permanent and temporary food businesses need Council approval/registration. No fee to register permanent; annual inspection fees apply. DA/CC or CDC may be required before trading.

councils.name: The Hills Shire Council
councils.notes: Online registration form. Annual administration fees by food-handler count and risk category. Inspection fees apply.

councils.name: Tweed Council
councils.notes: Application for food premises registration/change of details. Separate home-based food business application. Mobile vans need inspection before trade.

councils.name: Upper Hunter Council
councils.notes: Register before commencing via Food Premises Notification Details form. New fit-outs must meet AS4674 / FSANZ 3.2.3. Check NSW Food Authority notification where applicable.

councils.name: Wagga Wagga Council
councils.notes: Online retail food premises registration plus downloadable Food Business Registration Form. Covers permanent, mobile and temporary.

councils.name: Waverley Council
councils.notes: Food Premises New Business or Change of Ownership Application; Temporary/Mobile Food Application for temporary locations. Home-based (B&B, family daycare) register with Council. Annual inspections.

councils.name: Willoughby Council
councils.notes: Free registration for fixed, temporary stall and mobile food vehicle pathways.

councils.name: Wingecarribee Council
councils.notes: Online Food Business Notification Form for retail food businesses (except retail butchers).

councils.name: Wollondilly Council
councils.notes: Notify via Customer Portal before trading, including home-based. Development consent may be required.

councils.name: Wollongong City Council
councils.notes: Notify via Online Self Service before operating. Non-retail manufacturers/wholesalers notify NSW Food Authority instead.

councils.name: Woollahra Council
councils.notes: Submit Food Business Registration Form for new premises or ownership change. Inspection arranged after lodgement. Fees may apply.

councils.name: Yass Valley Council
councils.notes: Food Business and/or FSS Notification application ($50 from 1 Jul 2024; NFP/fundraiser/temporary market stalls exempt). Covers home-based, mobile, temporary stalls and B&Bs. Temporary stall registration two weeks prior. EHO inspections.
